steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
• Expand and electrify public transit and active-mobility infrastructure (buses, metros, bike lanes) to cut car use.  
• Retrofit buildings for energy efficiency—better insulation, LED lighting, heat-pump HVAC—and mandate high-performance standards for new construction.  
• Increase clean energy uptake: install rooftop solar, build district heating/cooling from renewables, and deploy widespread EV charging to shift vehicles to renewable electricity.
